_comment: Baseline for the nightly 8-GPU MXFP4 gate. Only mean_tflops_per_device and
mean_loss are read by ci/perf/parse_perf_log.py; every other key is
provenance for whoever has to decide whether a red night is real.
PROVISIONAL. This value came from a SOURCE build in the dev image on
smci355-ccs-aus-m15-29. The nightly measures a manylinux WHEEL on
smci355-ccs-aus-n15-13. Those differ in two ways that were never measured
together: a different clang (the manylinux image produces libmha_fwd/bwd
and librmsnorm_fwd 10-14% smaller than the dev image), and different
hardware. Leave `gate: false` on the workflow until several nights have
recorded where the wheel actually lands on that box, then replace the
numbers below with the median of those nights and turn the gate on.
Do NOT compare a ci_regression (FSDP4, batch 4, global 16) number against
this file. That profile's own baseline is ~1784.68 and reading it against
1840 shows a 3% regression that does not exist.
label: 8b_fp4_fsdp8

provenance.note: Frozen blog MXFP4 figure. Three further source runs of the same recipe gave 1837.1388 / 1838.1214 / 1840.0823 (mean 1839.00, sd 0.09%), so run-to-run spread on a quiet box is well under the 5% gate threshold.
